verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete. The implementation resolves TRIM_HORIZON from the durable log reader's retained-sequence horizon, rejects only anchored starts below that horizon with a bounded 410 response, preserves LATEST and overflow behavior, and documents the cached-horizon limitation honestly. The focused tests are non-vacuous: the end-to-end case forces real segment retention, reopens the server on the trimmed log, checks retained replay, below-horizon rejection without records, the exact resolved boundary, and LATEST; unit tests cover resolution and error rendering. No new correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident relative to the already-approved first round.
